worldcombat.skill.mimic.summary: Temporarily replace Mimic’s move slot with a target's or ally's recent move. Known non-Pokémon attacks are translated into corresponding moves, and the slot returns when the borrow ends.
worldcombat.skill.mimic.use.0: Borrow a target's or ally's move
worldcombat.skill.mimic.use.1: Throw a foe's set-up back at it
worldcombat.skill.mimic.use.2: Punish a heavy attack just used
worldcombat.skill.mimic.description.0: The line reaches a visible demonstrator within %1$s blocks (enemy or ally); reading takes %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.mimic.description.1: Only moves used within the last %1$s s are remembered; the borrowed move stays on the user for %2$s s, then returns.
worldcombat.skill.mimic.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.mimic.growth.0: From level %1$s the memory window is %2$s s and the hold %3$s s.
On: memory window x1.6 and hold x1.35 - reads older moves and keeps the borrowed one longer, but windup is slower and cooldown x1.4. Off: quick study, fast to read and fire, with a shorter window and hold.
worldcombat.skill.mimic.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of sending the line. Larger values borrow from further away.
worldcombat.skill.mimic.preference.ai.le: When on, the user may leave its post to mimic; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.mimic.world: A known native attack successfully used by a non-Pokémon within %1$s is translated into an existing move, borrowed for %2$s: ordinary melee→Tackle, sting→Poison Sting, ram→Headbutt, mace→Slam, arrow→Fury Attack, trident→Horn Attack, fireball→Ember, sonic boom→Sonic Boom, indirect magic→Psybeam. Unlisted attacks cannot be copied.
